findings.summary: pr_merge falls back to the raw head_commit when harvest_tip is unset (state.get('harvest_tip') or state.get('head_commit')). The harvest graph has no conditional edge after the worktree node, so a cherry-pick conflict/failure (outcome escalated) still flows linearly into pr_merge, which would then push and squash-merge the unwashed dd tip into main, recreating the leak this spec prevents. The primary success path correctly uses the clean tip.
